note: People born in the United States Virgin Islands are United States citizens; the United States issues no national identity card (6 U.S.C. § 554), so they hold none. Identity cards issued locally are of the state kind, with the driver's license.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 8 U.S.C. § 1406, Persons living in and born in the Virgin Islands
sources.said: all persons born in those islands on or after February 25, 1927, and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, are declared to be citizens of the United States at birth.

sources.title: LII, 6 U.S. Code § 554, National identification system not authorized (Pub. L. 107-296, title XV, § 1514)
sources.said: 6 U.S. Code § 554 - National identification system not authorized ... Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to authorize the development of a national identification system or card.
